## Is this you?

Most people who get in touch aren’t starting from nothing. They’ve got a website. It’s just not doing its job, and nobody’s looking after it.

sound familiar?

- Your website hasn’t changed since the day it launched
- Your agency is slow, and charges a fortune for tiny updates
- It looks fine on your laptop and falls apart on a phone
- It gets visitors, but hardly any of them get in touch
- Your website is DIY’d, and visitors can tell
- Nobody’s checked whether Google can even find you

the good news?

## Your Squarespace website designer, UK

I’m Nick Croce, a UK web designer. Most designers pick a lane. I didn’t. If Squarespace is the right tool for your business, I’ll build it there properly, as a Squarespace Platinum Partner. If you’ve outgrown it, or need something faster and fully bespoke, I build custom too, and I keep it running.

More than 250 sites in, for entrepreneurs, creatives, SMEs and agencies, the goal’s still the same: a site that looks the part, sounds like you, and turns visitors into customers. Not a nice-looking brochure that just sits there.

I’m based in the UK and work with clients across the US and Europe too, so you get a designer who knows both markets, sensible time zone overlap, and direct access to me. Not an account manager. Not a ticket queue. Me.

## How it works

A clear, collaborative process from start to finish. You deal with me at every stage, so nothing gets lost in translation.

1. Step 1 of 3

 ### Onboarding

 Book a discovery call to talk through your vision, what the site needs to do, and whether we’re the right fit for each other.

2. Step 2 of 3

 ### Design & development

 Once we’ve agreed the scope and you’ve accepted the proposal, the build begins: custom design, layouts and features, shared with you as it takes shape.

3. Step 3 of 3

 ### Handover

 When you’ve approved the finished website, it goes live. On a custom build you get bespoke handover training, so you feel confident running it yourself. On Managed-For-You, I take it from there.

## Good questions, straight answers

Not covered here? [Send me a message](https://www.designbyency.com/contact/#message)

no such thing as a silly question

### Do you build websites on Squarespace or custom code?

Both. If Squarespace fits your business (most do), I’ll build there as a Platinum Circle Partner. If you need something faster, fully bespoke, or beyond what Squarespace can do, I build custom too, and manage the hosting, domain and security so you don’t have to think about it.

### How much does a Squarespace website designer cost in the UK?

UK agencies typically quote £5,000 to £15,000 for a small business Squarespace site, and freelancers can be anywhere from a few hundred pounds up. My custom Squarespace builds start from £3,000 for a site that’s yours to keep, or the Managed-For-You plan is from £150 a month with the build included. Either way the figure is fixed in writing before any work starts.

### Why hire a Squarespace specialist rather than a general web designer?

Because Squarespace has quirks, and a designer who works across every platform learns them on your project. I’ve built on it hundreds of times, so I know what it does well, where it gets in the way, and how to push past its limits with custom code when a site needs it. You also deal directly with the person doing the work, not an account manager, and when it’s live you get training to run it yourself, or Managed-For-You if you’d rather never log in again.

### Do I need to be in Liverpool, or even in the UK, to work with you?

No. Every project runs remotely over video calls, start to finish, and that is how all 250+ sites were built: clients in Liverpool, Manchester and London, across the UK, nine in the United States and several in Europe. If a bigger project warrants meeting in person, I can do that in Liverpool, Manchester or London.

### What does it cost?

Bespoke builds you manage yourself start from £3,000, quoted per project. The Managed-For-You plan starts from £150 a month, billed annually, so the year is paid up front. Either way you get a fixed figure in writing after our first call, before any work starts.

### What’s included in the Managed-For-You plan?

Monthly updates, design refinements, bug fixes, performance and Core Web Vitals monitoring, plugin and code checks, and priority support for anything urgent. Essentially, your site stays fast, current and working without you lifting a finger.

### Do I have to sign up for the Managed-For-You plan, or can I manage my own site?

Entirely up to you. I build the site either way. Some clients want full control and proper training to run it themselves. Others want to never log in again. If you’re running it yourself, I build it custom in Squarespace, because it’s the easiest platform for a team to update, blog on and sell from. Custom-coded sites come with the Managed-For-You plan, since I look after the hosting and code.

### Is a custom-built site better for SEO than Squarespace?

Not automatically; it depends on execution. Squarespace has strong SEO fundamentals out of the box. A custom build gives more control over page speed, schema and technical SEO, which matters more as a site scales. I set both up properly from day one, so the platform isn’t the thing holding your rankings back.

### Do you charge VAT?

Not at the moment. Every price on this site is the full figure: there is no VAT added on top of it. If that ever changes, the figure in your written quote is the one you pay.

### Is the SEO add-on required?

No. The SEO Plan is an optional add-on for Managed-For-You clients, at £500 a quarter. Every quarter it covers a full technical SEO audit with fixes made on the spot, meta and schema updates, a page speed tune-up, an internal linking review, and a plain-English report. Most clients add it once the site’s live and they want to actively grow traffic, not just maintain it.

### Do you use AI to build the websites?

Yes, and it’s not something I’m trying to hide. AI tools handle the repetitive technical tasks behind a build, which is why my prices are lower than an agency’s, not because anything is skipped. The website itself is still built by me, a human, page by page: the design, the words, what goes where and why. Nothing goes live that I haven’t personally built and checked.

### Can you migrate my existing site?

Yes, whether that’s moving from WordPress, Wix or Webflow to Squarespace, or moving to a fully custom build managed by me. I’ll review what’s working and what isn’t, and rebuild without you losing the SEO equity you’ve already earned.

### How long does a project take?

Most projects take 3 to 6 weeks depending on complexity. Managed-For-You clients don’t have a hard finish line, since I keep working on the site after launch.

mainEntity.name: Do you build websites on Squarespace or custom code?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. If Squarespace fits your business (most do), I’ll build there as a Platinum Circle Partner. If you need something faster, fully bespoke, or beyond what Squarespace can do, I build custom too, and manage the hosting, domain and security so you don’t have to think about it.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Squarespace website designer cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: UK agencies typically quote £5,000 to £15,000 for a small business Squarespace site, and freelancers can be anywhere from a few hundred pounds up. My custom Squarespace builds start from £3,000 for a site that’s yours to keep, or the Managed-For-You plan is from £150 a month with the build included. Either way the figure is fixed in writing before any work starts.

mainEntity.name: Why hire a Squarespace specialist rather than a general web designer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because Squarespace has quirks, and a designer who works across every platform learns them on your project. I’ve built on it hundreds of times, so I know what it does well, where it gets in the way, and how to push past its limits with custom code when a site needs it. You also deal directly with the person doing the work, not an account manager, and when it’s live you get training to run it yourself, or Managed-For-You if you’d rather never log in again.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be in Liverpool, or even in the UK, to work with you?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Every project runs remotely over video calls, start to finish, and that is how all 250+ sites were built: clients in Liverpool, Manchester and London, across the UK, nine in the United States and several in Europe. If a bigger project warrants meeting in person, I can do that in Liverpool, Manchester or London.

Bespoke builds you manage yourself start from £3,000, quoted per project. The Managed-For-You plan starts from £150 a month, billed annually, so the year is paid up front. Either way you get a fixed figure in writing after our first call, before any work starts.

mainEntity.name: What’s included in the Managed-For-You plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Monthly updates, design refinements, bug fixes, performance and Core Web Vitals monitoring, plugin and code checks, and priority support for anything urgent. Essentially, your site stays fast, current and working without you lifting a finger.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to sign up for the Managed-For-You plan, or can I manage my own site?

acceptedAnswer.text: Entirely up to you. I build the site either way. Some clients want full control and proper training to run it themselves. Others want to never log in again. If you’re running it yourself, I build it custom in Squarespace, because it’s the easiest platform for a team to update, blog on and sell from. Custom-coded sites come with the Managed-For-You plan, since I look after the hosting and code.

mainEntity.name: Is a custom-built site better for SEO than Squarespace?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not automatically; it depends on execution. Squarespace has strong SEO fundamentals out of the box. A custom build gives more control over page speed, schema and technical SEO, which matters more as a site scales. I set both up properly from day one, so the platform isn’t the thing holding your rankings back.
Not at the moment. Every price on this site is the full figure: there is no VAT added on top of it. If that ever changes, the figure in your written quote is the one you pay.

No. The SEO Plan is an optional add-on for Managed-For-You clients, at £500 a quarter. Every quarter it covers a full technical SEO audit with fixes made on the spot, meta and schema updates, a page speed tune-up, an internal linking review, and a plain-English report. Most clients add it once the site’s live and they want to actively grow traffic, not just maintain it.

mainEntity.name: Do you use AI to build the websites?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and it’s not something I’m trying to hide. AI tools handle the repetitive technical tasks behind a build, which is why my prices are lower than an agency’s, not because anything is skipped. The website itself is still built by me, a human, page by page: the design, the words, what goes where and why. Nothing goes live that I haven’t personally built and checked.

mainEntity.name: Can you migrate my existing site?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, whether that’s moving from WordPress, Wix or Webflow to Squarespace, or moving to a fully custom build managed by me. I’ll review what’s working and what isn’t, and rebuild without you losing the SEO equity you’ve already earned.

mainEntity.name: How long does a project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most projects take 3 to 6 weeks depending on complexity. Managed-For-You clients don’t have a hard finish line, since I keep working on the site after launch.
